seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 steps 5 cells per A1-A4; a dest box with any colour-4/5 cell or off-board is blocked (still costs 2).
A full 5-cell colour-1 strip just outside a dest edge is a conveyor: the player slides away from it until blocked.
Every action turns the two leftmost bar cells (colour 11) to 3; covering a refuel consumes it and refills the bar; covering a 'collect' rotates the HUD glyph 90 deg CW.
Hidden state: the underlay under the player, used only when the incoming frame equals the last returned frame (otherwise the player box is painted 3).
Not observed, so unconfirmed: recolor token (glyph colour -> 9) and the chamber lock (free reject while the glyph does not match the legend).
